group: Valid version flags - each supported Draft

cases.expected: JsonSchemaFactory instance with defaultMetaSchemaURI == "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#" and contains the V4 meta‑schema
cases.description: When a supported Draft‑04 flag is supplied, getInstance should return a non‑null factory whose default meta‑schema URI matches the V4 meta‑schema URI.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaFactory instance with defaultMetaSchemaURI == "http://json-schema.org/draft-06/schema#" and contains the V6 meta‑schema
cases.description: When a supported Draft‑06 flag is supplied, getInstance should return a factory configured for Draft‑06.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaFactory instance with defaultMetaSchemaURI == "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#" and contains the V7 meta‑schema
cases.description: When a supported Draft‑07 flag is supplied, getInstance should return a factory configured for Draft‑07.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaFactory instance with defaultMetaSchemaURI == "https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema#" and contains the 2019‑09 meta‑schema
cases.description: When the 2019‑09 flag is supplied, getInstance should return a factory configured for the 2019‑09 draft.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaFactory instance with defaultMetaSchemaURI == "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema#" and contains the 2020‑12 meta‑schema
cases.description: When the 2020‑12 flag is supplied, getInstance should return a factory configured for the 2020‑12 draft.
Passing a null flag should cause the method to abort with an exception because checkVersion cannot resolve a null version.

group: Invalid version flag - unsupported enum constant

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown by checkVersion indicating unsupported version
cases.description: If an enum constant that is not mapped to any JsonSchemaVersion is supplied, checkVersion must reject it and getInstance should propagate the exception.

cases.expected: Two distinct JsonSchemaFactory objects are returned on successive calls (different object references)
cases.description: Calling getInstance with the same supported flag twice must produce independent factory instances; the method should not cache or reuse a singleton.

cases.expected: Two distinct JsonSchemaFactory objects are returned on successive calls (different object references)
cases.description: Even for the latest draft, getInstance must create a fresh factory each invocation.

group: Meta‑schema registration count and key normalization

cases.expected: Factory's internal jsonMetaSchemas map has size 1 and contains the normalized key "http://json-schema.org/draft-06/schema#"
cases.description: After getInstance(V6) the factory should register only the Draft‑06 meta‑schema; the key must be the normalized URI returned by JsonMetaSchema.getUri().

cases.expected: Factory's internal jsonMetaSchemas map has size 1 and contains the normalized key "https://json-schema.org/draft/2019-09/schema#"
cases.description: For the 2019‑09 draft the factory must contain exactly one meta‑schema entry with the correct HTTPS URI.

group: Builder defaults are not altered by getInstance

cases.expected: Returned JsonSchemaFactory has enableUriSchemaCache == true and its uriTranslators collection is empty (default state)
cases.description: getInstance should build the factory using the Builder's default configuration; no custom URI translators or cache settings are introduced automatically.
